Usage: agentcage cage prune [OPTIONS]

  Remove all exited interactive and ephemeral cages.

Options:
  -y, --yes            Skip confirmation prompt
  --dry-run            List the cages that would be removed without changing
                       anything.
  --older-than TEXT    Only cages stopped more than this long ago (e.g. 30m,
                       1h, 2d).
  --help               Show this message and exit.
